title: 消融换手率排名：只按股息率TTM选前10
hypothesis: 若低换手独立贡献（流动性溢价 claim），objective 下降且 maxDD 抬高
design: baseline.py 中 total_rank = dy_rank*3（换手权重 0），其余不动，--window train
result: top-10 by dividend-yield TTM alone earns nothing (annual -0.20%, maxdd 26.38%): the whole base result depends on the low-turnover rank

title: 消融股息率排名：只在派息股里按20日低换手选前10
hypothesis: 若股息率是收益来源，objective 大幅下降；若不降，收益来自低换手/派息股资格本身
design: total_rank = turnover_rank*3（仍保留 dy_ttm>0 的派息股池），--window train
result: low 20d turnover among dividend payers alone gives annual 11.56% at maxdd 11.28% — positive but far below the combination; removing the yield rank costs 0.132 obj

title: 规模混淆：universe 限定中证800
hypothesis: 若超额来自股息率而非小盘暴露，限定 000906 成分后 objective 基本保持
design: get_stock_pool 改为 get_index_stocks(000906.XSHG) ∩ 原过滤，其余不动
result: inside CSI800 the same rule keeps ~60% of the objective (annual 17.89% vs 22.61%) at an unchanged drawdown; the remaining ~0.054 comes from names outside the 800

title: regime：2022 与 2023 分年
hypothesis: 高股息在 2022 熊市防御、2023 红利行情领涨，两年都为正；若只一年贡献则是单一 regime
result: the base earns about equally in both years against a falling benchmark; yield-only fails ENTIRELY in the 2022 bear (-14.31, the whole 26% drawdown) and works in 2023, while turnover-only is the better of the two in 2022

title: 持仓数敏感性 10 -> 5 / 20
hypothesis: 高股息因子是宽截面效应，20 只应接近或优于 10 只；5 只若骤变则 10 只结果靠少数票
result: 5 and 10 names score alike (0.120 / 0.135) while widening to 20 costs 0.057 at the same drawdown: the return is concentrated in the top of the rank-sum, not spread across a broad high-yield/low-turnover sleeve

title: 调仓相位敏感性：计数器起点偏移 12 天
hypothesis: 25 日周期若无相位依赖，偏移后 objective 变化 < 0.03
design: g.day_count 初值 12（首日仍调仓），其余不动
result: shifting the 25-day rebalance calendar by 12 days changes the objective by only -0.006 with an identical drawdown

title: 借 2596a8ab：股息率改用近3年累计分红/市值
hypothesis: 三年平均股息率滤掉一次性特别分红，提高股息率信号质量，objective 上升
design: get_dividend_yield_ttm 改为 3 年 bonus_amount_rmb 累计/3 ÷ market_cap
result: replacing TTM yield with a 3-year average dividend yield cuts the objective to -0.0107, about the level of turnover-only (q-2 0.0028) — the smoothed yield adds almost nothing on top of the turnover rank

title: 借 1a8a41cf：加 ST/退市/次新过滤
hypothesis: 高股息 ST 票是价值陷阱，剔除后回撤下降
design: get_stock_pool 增加 is_st/名称含ST退 与上市<250日过滤
result: the ST filter barely moves the base (Δ -0.002, identical drawdown): the rank-sum essentially never selects ST names on TRAIN

title: 借 1a8a41cf：盈利质量过滤（PE 5-50, ROE>5, 净利增速>0）
hypothesis: 剔除股息率高但盈利恶化的价值陷阱，objective 上升
design: 股息率排名前先用 get_fundamentals 过滤
result: adding the quality/growth screen before the rank-sum turns the book negative (annual -1.92%, maxdd 19.34%), nearly as bad as yield-only

title: 只按股息率 + ST/退/次新过滤：困境股是否就是价值陷阱
hypothesis: 若 q-1 的失败来自 ST/困境高股息股，过滤后纯股息率 objective 明显回升
design: q-1 + get_stock_pool 滤 is_st / 名称含 ST 退 / 上市<250日
result: removing ST/delisting/<250-day listings leaves yield-only as bad as before (annual -0.47%, maxdd 25.42%); the picks changed but the loss did not

title: 条件关系：低换手三分之一内按股息率选 vs 高换手三分之一内按股息率选
hypothesis: 低换手 tercile 内纯股息率 ≈ 基类；高换手 tercile 内显著为负
design: 派息股按 turnover_20d 三分位切，tercile 内按 dy_rank 取前10；两跑
result: pure yield within the lowest-turnover tercile still falls well short of the base (-0.0663 vs 0.1348) while within the highest tercile it tracks the market crash (-0.4574); turnover level orders the results monotonically (high tercile < low tercile < rank-sum base)

title: 排名权重 dy:turnover = 3:1 与 1:3
hypothesis: 二者互补，权重在 1:1 附近是平台；偏任一端向 q-1/q-2 退化
design: total_rank 权重改 3:1 与 1:3 各一跑
result: objective peaks at equal weights and falls ~0.08 symmetrically when either rank is tilted 3x, i.e. a single sharp peak rather than a plateau; with the full sweep endpoints q-1 (-0.2658) and q-2 (0.0028) the curve is -0.27 / 0.06 / 0.13 / 0.05 / 0.00

title: 更新鲜的股息率：按董事会预案公告日计近12个月派息
hypothesis: i-1 显示股息率腿的价值在于新近派息；提前约2个月用预案公告日计入，objective 上升
design: get_dividend_yield_ttm 的日期过滤由 a_registration_date 改为 board_plan_pub_date，去掉 plan_progress 过滤（避免用到事后状态），其余不动
result: counting dividends from their board announcement instead of registration costs 0.018 obj with a slightly higher drawdown

title: 换手率窗口敏感性 20 -> 10 / 60 日
hypothesis: 若低换手是持续的低关注属性（流动性溢价），60 日应不差于 20 日；10 日若明显更好则是短期噪声而非属性
result: 20 days is the best of the three; 60 days loses less than 10 days and has the lowest drawdown, so shortening the window hurts more than lengthening it
